title: Qwen APP supports China Mobile's computing power plan. Users can activate it in the Work Assistant.
excerpt: On September 28, the Qwen app and PC version have been integrated with China Mobile's computing power package. Users who have subscribed to this service can use
content_html:
On September 28, the Qwen app and PC version have been integrated with China Mobile's computing power package. Users who have subscribed to this service can use the Token quota in their China Mobile account to complete complex work tasks in the "Work Assistant" section of the Qwen app or PC. The relevant Tokens will be deducted from the user's corresponding account.

At the same time, both parties have also launched the "Qwen x China Mobile Co-branded Version." Users who sign up for a designated package can enjoy Qwen membership benefits. This cooperation will first be piloted in key city areas such as Guangdong, Hunan, Hubei, and Jiangsu, and then gradually expanded nationwide.
